title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Bulldog spirit at Drake University, from painted streets to pageant-winning pups.

cards.title: Painting the Pavement
cards.subtitle: A colorful kickoff to Relays week
cards.notes: Student groups raffle for squares on Carpenter Avenue to paint murals matching the annual Relays theme. The street remains a vibrant campus centerpiece throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition where student organizations paint murals on a designated campus street to celebrate the Drake Relays.
cards.evidence_claim: Student organizations enter a raffle to earn a spot on the street and paint designs correlating with the Relays theme.
cards.source_title: Student organizations celebrate beloved Drake Relays tradition: Painted Street
cards.access_notes: The street is a public campus walkway located on Carpenter Avenue between Cowles Library and Jewett Hall.

cards.title: The Most Beautiful Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A pageant for the wrinkliest contestants
cards.notes: Watch 24 English Bulldogs compete for the crown at the Knapp Center. The winner serves as the official mascot for the Drake Relays and receives a key to the city.
cards.short_summary: A nationally recognized pageant where English Bulldogs compete to be named the official mascot of the Drake Relays.
cards.evidence_claim: The 47th Annual Beautiful Bulldog Contest in 2026 crowned Flora as the champion to serve as the official Relays mascot.
cards.source_title: The Beautiful Bulldog Contest® | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the Knapp Center; open to the public to attend and watch the pageant.

cards.title: Pucker Up at the Rock
cards.subtitle: A 40-ton boulder of romantic luck
cards.notes: Legend says couples who kiss on this rock at midnight will have a lifetime of happiness. It marks the spot where the university's founder first declared the campus site.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus boulder near Old Main associated with romantic legends and university founding history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kissing Rock has remained outside Old Main since 1898 as a mythic stone that gives luck to Drake couples who kiss there.
cards.source_title: SAA Kissing Rock - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Located on the southeast corner of Old Main; accessible 24/7 as a campus landmark.

cards.title: Hubbelling Down the Hill
cards.subtitle: Improvised winter sledding
cards.notes: When snow hits, students use trays (or modern alternatives) to sled down the hills of the Quads. The name comes from the Hubbell Dining Hall trays once used for the sport.
cards.short_summary: A winter tradition of sledding down campus hills, historically using trays from the dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hubbelling is a winter downhill sport named for the trays from Hubbell Dining Hall used as sleds.
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the hills near the Quad dormitory area during snowfall.

cards.title: The Return of Old Brassie
cards.subtitle: Ringing in the Relays
cards.notes: Revived in 2026 after 40 years, the ringing of the Old Main bell now signals the start of the annual Paint Fight and Relays week festivities.
cards.short_summary: The ceremonial ringing of the historic Old Main bell to mark the beginning of major campus celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake University revived its bell-ringing tradition after 40 years to signal the start of the Paint Fight and Relays week.
cards.source_title: Old Brassie is back - Drake University
cards.access_notes: The bell is located in the tower of Old Main; the ringing ceremony is held outdoors nearby.

cards.title: The Annual Paint Fight
cards.subtitle: A messy start to the week
cards.notes: Hundreds of students gather between Cowles Library and Painted Street for a massive, colorful paint fight. Participants must use latex-free and oil-free paint.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy event where students throw paint at each other to celebrate the start of Relays week.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake students are invited to Painted Street to join in the chaos of the annual Paint Fight.
cards.access_notes: Held in the open area between Cowles Library and Painted Street.

cards.title: Rubbing Griff for Luck
cards.subtitle: A bronze bulldog blessing
cards.notes: Located in Bulldog Plaza, this larger-than-life bronze sculpture of the live mascot Griff is a popular spot for students to rub for good luck before exams or games.
cards.short_summary: A bronze statue of the university's live mascot that serves as a focal point for campus luck and photos.
cards.evidence_claim: The larger-than-life Griff statue in Bulldog Plaza is a central campus attraction for students and alumni.
cards.source_title: Drake University Bulldog Plaza - Hansen Company
cards.access_notes: Located in Bulldog Plaza in front of Old Main; accessible to the public.

cards.title: Fridays with the Mascot
cards.subtitle: Weekly meet-and-greets
cards.notes: Every Friday, the live mascot Griff (currently Griff III) holds office hours in Cowles Hall to meet with prospective students and provide stress relief for current ones.
cards.short_summary: A weekly event where the live bulldog mascot interacts with the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Griff can be spotted meeting with prospective students at 'Fridays with Griff' in Cowles Hall.
cards.source_title: The Evolution of the Bulldog - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Held weekly in Cowles Hall; check the mascot's social media for specific times.

cards.title: The Cheeseburger Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A whimsical dining hall guardian
cards.notes: This unique painted statue outside Hubbell Dining Hall features a bulldog wearing a chef's hat. It was recently restored to honor a long-time university staff member's mother.
cards.short_summary: A beloved, whimsical bulldog statue located outside the main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The cheeseburger bulldog statue outside of Hubbell Dining Hall was repainted and returned to campus with an added chef's hat.
cards.source_title: Cheeseburger Griff returns after one and a half years - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Located outside Hubbell Dining Hall; visible to all passersby.

cards.title: Running the Blue Oval
cards.subtitle: The heart of America's Athletic Classic
cards.notes: The iconic blue track at Drake Stadium is the site of the Drake Relays. Students and community members finish the Drake Road Races here to kick off the week.
cards.short_summary: The world-famous blue track at Drake Stadium, central to the university's athletic identity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Relays returns to Drake Stadium for its 116th edition, drawing fans to the iconic Blue Oval.
cards.source_title: The Blue Oval Awaits: Your Essential Guide to the 116th Drake Relays
cards.access_notes: Located inside Drake Stadium; access is typically restricted to events and scheduled races.
